strategies.text:
Overview

Fire blast is one of the hardest routes for Palkia for two reasons.

  1. The catch tanks are weaker with Baxcalibur having both a narrower catch tank window & less DPS.
  2. The rotation Eternatus must do to reach 4 dynamax cannons per phase can often place it near 1-5hp, just enough to faint to a dragon breath which is observed to increase phantom rejoin likelihood.

In the current meta this route may be the hardest Palkia route among all 4 dragon breath + charge movesets aside from Aqua tail if completed with Mega Rayquaza. The route is almost entirely determined by RNG. Make sure to complete fast rejoins.

Est Time to Win: 299-300s

Main Strategy

Eternatus: Must be 15 attack.

Aim for 4 Dynamax cannons per cycle. This can be achieved 5 ways.

  1. [Ideal] Palkia only does 1 fire blast
  2. [Rare/Ideal] Palkia dragon breaths all the way through giving you 5 dynamax cannons
  3. [Ok] Palkia does 2 fire blasts. 1 is caught, the other absorbed.
  4. [Slow, high risk] Palkia does 3+ fire blasts. 2 are caught, 1 is absorbed.
  5. [Slow-ok, high risk]Palkia does 4 fire blasts. 2 are caught by baxcalibur, 2 are absorbed but a 5th one is cast in transition allowing the 4th dynamax cannon to go through.

Make sure not to overtap Dragon tails as dragon breath can often top off energy.

[Support DPS Option 1] Mega Dragonite:

Aim for 2 Outrage+ This can be achieved 3-4 ways

  1. Ideal: Palkia does 3 fire blasts, 1 in transition, 2 b2b.
  2. Ok: Palkia does 2 fire blasts, fully absorbed
  3. Ok-slow: Palkia does 2 fire blasts, 1 CT'd
  4. Slow: Palkia does 1 fire blast or 0 fire blasts. (Make up DPS later or bail)

Make sure not to overtap Dragon tails as dragon breath can often top off energy.

[Support DPS Option 2] Mega Rayquaza:

Aim for 7-8 breaking swipes gained from tanking consecutive fire blasts. Weave breaking swipes inside fire blast cast animation to maximize chance.

  1. Ideal: Palkia does 3 fire blasts, grants you 7-8 breaking swipes immediately.
  2. Ideal-Ok: Palkia does 2 fire blasts quickly, grants you 5-6 breaking swipes.
  3. Ok: Palkia does 2 slow fire blasts, grants you 6-7 breaking swipes over a long time
  4. Slow: Palkia does 1 Fire blast, grants 5-6 breakings swipes over long time
  5. Bail: Palkia does not fire blast.


Baxcalibur:

Catch tank poorly timed fire blasts; optionally trail or drive by.

  1. Catch tank poorly timed fire blasts; those that would overflow in energy.
  2. Trailing CT is okay if fire blast timing is 1t offset from last charge move hit.
  3. Drive by CT is okay if fire blast timing is 1t offset during switch from Main to Support DPS.
  4. Drive by CT is a catch tank interaction when swapping from Main to Support DPS. Happens by chance.

Shadow Haxorus/Garchomp:

Execute the boss last cycle if not using Mega Rayquaza or if support DPS is too low.
